name: One spectacular myth, complete verdict
promise: A familiar-looking claim gets a decisive test.
hook: Show the car or object poised for the unusual test and state the claim in plain words.
production_need: Crop or recapture one complete long-form myth with a wide enough vertical frame.
cost_basis: Reuse: $60–$180 edit allowance; new capture $180–$650 plus only new setup.

name: Several fast tests with a final favorite
promise: A short, accurately counted batch of claims yields visible verdicts.
hook: Lead with the hardest claim, then begin the easiest test immediately.
production_need: Use only distinct filmed tests; fewer complete tests beat an inflated count.
cost_basis: Reuse: $90–$220 edit allowance for the extra sequencing, counted outside long-form only once.

name: One obvious constraint, one goal
promise: A familiar goal becomes hard because a single restriction is visible.
hook: A normal action immediately hits the new limit.
production_need: Native simple custom rule or a self-contained attempt from the course/prank episode; no rules menu.
cost_basis: $180–$650 native capture/edit plus $0–$300 only if new game setup is needed.

name: Hidden entrance with a real reveal
promise: A normal-looking surface opens into an unexpected functional space.
hook: Show the suspicious ordinary exterior and the host’s knowing reaction.
production_need: Capture entrance continuity and an actual usable interior; source shelf classification is provisional.
cost_basis: $60–$180 reuse edit; a new room is paid by its long-form build profile, not charged again here.

name: Absurd scale or body-size consequence
promise: One immediately readable scale change creates a fresh problem.
hook: Show the tiny player or enormous object against an ordinary familiar thing.
production_need: Shorts source establishes the size-constraint family; GTA vehicle/experiment adaptation remains a hypothesis.
cost_basis: Reuse $60–$180; new native episode $180–$650 plus scoped mod adjustments.

name: Audience knows the obstacle before the player
promise: Viewers see the constraint, then a crew member discovers its consequence.
hook: Reveal one hidden change visually and immediately cut to the affected attempt.
production_need: The source proves a visible constraint example, not this crew-prank variant; format is a launch test supported by long-form 12.
cost_basis: $60–$180 reuse edit, preserve separate operator and player footage.
